jobs.snippet: Technical Recruiter Who We Are Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too. We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable wi
jobs.desc: Technical Recruiter Who We Are Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too. We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more. Our team is small relative to our impact, and we believe our users’ success is our success (not the inverse). A team member summarized: “Roboflow is a company full of giant brains and tiny egos.” We find software has a multiplier effect on all roles (not only product and engineering), so Roboflow employs developers across the company in design, sales, customer support, marketing, and beyond. We’re supported by great customers and investors, having raised over $63 million from Google Ventures, Y Combinator, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, and other leading software investors. What We're Looking For Primarily, you like making great things with passionate colleagues. You prefer owning outcomes to completing tasks, and you're motivated by helping exceptional people find work where they can have outsized impact. You're fascinated by how strong technical organizations are built. You enjoy understanding what makes great engineers, product managers, designers, and researchers effective—and helping hiring teams identify those signals early. We are less concerned with the number of years you've spent recruiting than with the impact you've had. You know recruiting is not simply about filling open positions. Exceptional hiring compounds across an organization for years. You approach recruiting as a strategic function that helps shape the future of a company. You are constantly asking, “How can this be better?” Whether improving sourcing approaches, candidate experience, interview design, or recruiting systems, you look for opportunities to raise the bar. You understand how strong product and technical teams operate. jobs.desc: Headquarters: Remote About the Team At Netlify, we’re a remote-first, globally distributed company with 120+ employees working across 13 countries around the world. Together, we’re building the platform for building and shipping web apps, with a mission to help anyone bring their ideas to the web. As a Talent Partner, you’ll play a key role in bringing in the people who will shape Netlify’s next stage of growth. You’ll partner closely with hiring leaders to help them make thoughtful, high-quality hiring decisions and will be deeply embedded in understanding this evolving job market and what makes not only great talent, but folks who align with Netlify’s mission. With our team, you’ll recruit across a wide variety of teams and talent markets, owning the full recruiting lifecycle and partnering closely with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Product, Finance and other functions. Rather than specializing in one area, you’ll build context quickly, learn what great talent looks like across different parts of the business, and help us find and hire exceptional people. We’ve already built a number of our own tools and workflows on Netlify to make our day-to-day work better, and we’re continuing to experiment with how AI can create even more leverage. With our team, you’ll be using the same platform you’re helping grow the team behind by shipping tools that improve your own work, experimenting with new ways of working, and contributing to how we continue to evolve how we hire. You'll be our dedicated recruiter, so you'll set the baselines for time to fill, candidate response time, and offer acceptance, and then own improving them. Candidates judge us by how we treat them. No one waits for an answer, and when something inside our own process is slowing a candidate down, you'll find it and fix it. We would rather give someone a clear no quickly than leave them guessing. You'll also help shape how we recruit. If the role converts to full-time, you'll help build and scale the recruiting function as we grow. You will hire for our mid to lower level roles from intake through offer, and you will build sourcing pipelines in the areas where we hire often, so outreach to strong candidates starts within 24 hours of a role opening. Second, you will run recruiting operations. You will own our applicant tracking system and workflows, use AI agents to take manual steps out of hiring, and help hiring managers and interview teams prepare to hire well. You will also support our other in-house recruiter by taking on parts of recruiting operations for our more senior level hires. Hiring managers will know you as the person to go to for process and recruiting operations help. The pace is fast and the team values people who ask good questions, learn quickly, think ahead, and change course when the situation calls for it. This role reports to the Head of Talent & Culture. What You'll Do Hire end to end. Partner with hiring managers to fill mid to lower level roles from intake through offer, with a clear understanding of each position and the team it supports. Run our ATS. Own the setup, workflows, and day-to-day operation of our applicant tracking system so our hiring process runs consistently inside it. Put AI to work. Build and maintain AI agent workflows that work well, stay current as technology changes, and reduce manual steps in hiring. Standardize and measure. Keep hiring steps and documents consistent from role to role, and manage our hiring data and dashboard so leaders can see how hiring is going. Support senior-level hiring. Partner with our other in-house recruiter on more senior level searches by supporting parts of recruiting operations. Equip hiring managers. Run the hiring intake process, support strong hiring scorecards, create interview guides, and build resources such as case scenarios or projects; train hiring managers and interview teams to hire well. Be the go-to partner. Become the person hiring managers turn to for solutions on process and recruiting

Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success. We grow together and are stronger together. What’s unique about this role? The Recruiting Coordinator assists in oversight of the full recruitment cycle on behalf of the Managed Review Recruiting and Operations functions, supports key employee lifecycle logistics, and serves as a champion for consistency and accuracy across all areas of responsibility. The Recruiting Coordinator functions as a shared service within Managed Review with flexibility and expertise to assist with PAC (People and Culture) functions as needed. What will this person do? Coordinates end-to-end processes for Managed Review candidates and new hires with attention to compliance, candidate experience, new hire experience, and efficiency. Ensures new hires are equipped to use employee-facing HRIS functions and are eligible to work in the U.S. Maintains candidate databases, while tracking recruitment metrics and ensuring compliance with HR policies. Supports Managed Review Recruitment by screening resumes, scheduling and conducting candidate interviews. Takes ownership of a smooth and positive candidate experience from interview to onboarding to assignment conclusion. Manages new hire paperwork while ensuring confidentiality and compliance with applicable laws. Writes, posts, and manages Managed Review job postings and job descriptions on career websites. Serves as point of contact for contract employee process. Identifies and acts upon process improvement in areas of responsibility, in coordination with recruiting team. Assists with implementation of Managed Review operations processes related to project initiation, set-up, and reporting. Collaborates and communicates with key stakeholders interdepartmentally related to Managed Review, talent acquisition, new hires, and other PAC related needs. Performs other duties as assigned.
